class Params(string missing, string scaling, string components, real64 cumulative, int repetitions, int seed, real64 t2_limit, real64 spe_limit, int cycles, int top, int scree_width, int biplot_width, int biplot_height, int radius, int diagnostic_width, int diagnostic_height)

Table read_table(string path)
    contents := lines(path)
    header := contents[0].split(",")
    string[] ids := []
    string[][] rows := []
    for: 1 <= index < int(#contents)
        fields := contents[index].split(",")
        ids = ids.append(fields[0])
        rows = rows.append(fields[1:<int(#fields)])
    return Table(header[1:<int(#header)], ids, rows)

Inputs read_inputs()
    settings := [for line := lines("input/params.txt")[] then line.split(" ")]
    params := Params(settings[0][1], settings[1][1], settings[2][1], decimal(settings[3][1]), integer(settings[4][1]), integer(settings[4][2]), decimal(settings[5][1]), decimal(settings[6][1]), integer(settings[7][1]), integer(settings[8][1]), integer(settings[9][1]), integer(settings[10][1]), integer(settings[10][2]), integer(settings[11][1]), integer(settings[12][1]), integer(settings[12][2]))
    return Inputs(read_table("input/data.csv"), read_table("input/supplementary.csv"), params)

public import matrix = "./matrix.qui"

class Result(real64[] values, real64[][] vectors, int sweeps)
class Power(real64 value, real64[] vector, int agreement, bool matched)

real64 off(real64[][] values)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for: p < int(#values) - 1
        for: p + 1 <= q < int(#values)
            result += values[p][q] * values[p][q]
    return result

void rotate(real64[][] &a, real64[][] &vectors, int p, int q)
    off_diagonal := a[p][q]
    if off_diagonal == 0.0
        return
    theta := (a[q][q] - a[p][p]) / (2.0 * off_diagonal)
    t := 1.0 / (matrix.absolute(theta) + matrix.root(theta * theta + 1.0))
    if theta < 0.0
        t = -t
    c := 1.0 / matrix.root(t * t + 1.0)
    s := t * c
    for: r < int(#a)
        if r == p or r == q
            continue
        rp := a[r][p]
        rq := a[r][q]
        a[r][p] = c * rp - s * rq
        a[p][r] = a[r][p]
        a[r][q] = s * rp + c * rq
        a[q][r] = a[r][q]
    a[p][p] -= t * off_diagonal
    a[q][q] += t * off_diagonal
    a[p][q] = 0.0
    a[q][p] = 0.0
    for: r < int(#vectors)
        rp := vectors[r][p]
        rq := vectors[r][q]
        vectors[r][p] = c * rp - s * rq
        vectors[r][q] = s * rp + c * rq

Result jacobi(real64[][] values)
    a := matrix.copy(values)
    vectors := matrix.identity(int(#values))
    initial := off(a)
    count := 0
    if initial > 0.0
        for: 1 <= sweep <= 100
            for: p < int(#values) - 1
                for: p + 1 <= q < int(#values)
                    rotate(&a, &vectors, p, q)
            remaining := off(a)
            if count == 0 and remaining < 1.0e-16 * initial
                count = sweep
            if remaining < 1.0e-22 * initial
                break
    int[] order := []
    for: index < int(#values)
        place := int(#order)
        for: position < int(#order)
            previous := order[position]
            if a[index][index] > a[previous][previous]
                place = position
                break
        order = order[0:<place].append(index).concat(order[place:<int(#order)])
    real64[] eigenvalues := []
    real64[][] eigenvectors := []
    for index := order[]
        eigenvalues = eigenvalues.append(a[index][index])
        eigenvectors = eigenvectors.append(matrix.orient(matrix.normalize(matrix.column(vectors, index))))
    return Result(eigenvalues, eigenvectors, count)

Power[] power(real64[][] values, Result reference)
    work := matrix.copy(values)
    Power[] result := []
    for: k < int(#values)
        real64[] x := [for row := values[] then 1.0]
        agreement := -1
        opposite := [for value := reference.vectors[k][] then -value]
        for: 1 <= iteration <= 1000
            x = matrix.normalize(matrix.product(work, x))
            first := matrix.maximum_difference(x, reference.vectors[k])
            second := matrix.maximum_difference(x, opposite)
            difference := if first < second then first else second
            if agreement < 0 and difference < 0.000001
                agreement = iteration
        product := matrix.product(work, x)
        value := matrix.dot(x, product)
        vector := matrix.orient(matrix.normalize(x))
        matched := matrix.absolute(value - reference.values[k]) <= 1.0e-8 * reference.values[0] and matrix.maximum_difference(vector, reference.vectors[k]) <= 0.000001
        result = result.append(Power(value, vector, agreement, matched))
        work = matrix.deflate(work, value, vector)
    return result

import dataset = "./dataset.qui"
import matrix = "./matrix.qui"
import eigen = "./eigen.qui"
import pca = "./pca.qui"
import plot = "./plot.qui"

string number(real64 value, digits := 4)
    result := if digits == 6 then "{value:.6}" else "{value:.4}"
    if result == "-0.0000" or result == "-0.000000"
        return result[1:<int(#result)]
    return result

string reals(real64[] values, separator := " ")
    fields := [for value := values[] then number(value)]
    return fields.join(separator)

real64 sum_values(real64[] values)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

int argmax(real64[] values)
    result := 0
    for: 1 <= index < int(#values)
        if values[index] > values[result]
            result = index
    return result

int[] top_indices(real64[] values, int count)
    int[] order := []
    for: index < int(#values)
        place := int(#order)
        for: position < int(#order)
            if values[index] > values[order[position]]
                place = position
                break
        order = order[0:<place].append(index).concat(order[place:<int(#order)])
    limit := if count < int(#order) then count else int(#order)
    return order[0:<limit]

real64 congruence(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    return matrix.dot(first, second) / matrix.root(matrix.dot(first, first) * matrix.dot(second, second))

class Summary(int observed, int missing, real64 mean, real64 sd, real64 minimum, real64 maximum)
class Descriptive(Summary[] summaries, string[] incomplete)
class AnalysisData(string[] ids, real64[][] rows)
class Adequacy(real64[] msa, real64 determinant, real64 kmo, real64 bartlett, int degrees)
class Retention(real64 total, real64 average, real64[] ratios, real64[] cumulative, real64[] broken, real64[] standard_errors, bool[] separated, int[] criteria, int retained)
class Loadings(real64[][] values, real64[] communalities, real64[][] correlations)
class Rotation(real64[][] loadings, real64[] squares, real64[] criteria, int[] closest, real64[] congruences)
class Diagnostic(real64 t2, real64 spe, real64 quality, string flag, real64[] t2_contributions, real64[] spe_contributions)
class Nearest(int index, real64 distance)

Descriptive summarize(string[] ids, string[][] rows, int size)
    Summary[] summaries := []
    for: j < size
        real64[] values := []
        real64 total := 0.0
        for row := rows[]
            if row[j] != "NA"
                value := dataset.decimal(row[j])
                values = values.append(value)
                total += value
        mean := total / matrix.as_real(int(#values))
        real64 squares := 0.0
        minimum := values[0]
        maximum := values[0]
        for value := values[]
            squares += (value - mean) * (value - mean)
            if value < minimum
                minimum = value
            if value > maximum
                maximum = value
        summaries = summaries.append(Summary(int(#values), int(#rows) - int(#values), mean, matrix.root(squares / matrix.as_real(int(#values) - 1)), minimum, maximum))
    string[] incomplete := []
    for: index < int(#rows)
        missing := false
        for value := rows[index][]
            if value == "NA"
                missing = true
        if missing
            incomplete = incomplete.append(ids[index])
    return Descriptive(summaries, incomplete)

AnalysisData analysis_data(string[] ids, string[][] rows, Summary[] summaries, string strategy)
    string[] retained_ids := []
    real64[][] retained_rows := []
    for: index < int(#rows)
        row := rows[index]
        complete := true
        real64[] values := []
        for: j < int(#summaries)
            if row[j] == "NA"
                complete = false
                values = values.append(summaries[j].mean)
            else
                values = values.append(dataset.decimal(row[j]))
        if strategy == "mean" or complete
            retained_ids = retained_ids.append(ids[index])
            retained_rows = retained_rows.append(values)
    return AnalysisData(retained_ids, retained_rows)

Adequacy sampling_adequacy(real64[][] correlation, int n)
    size := int(#correlation)
    solved := matrix.inverse_determinant(correlation)
    inverse := solved.values
    determinant := solved.determinant
    real64[] msa := []
    real64 rr_total := 0.0
    real64 pp_total := 0.0
    for: j < size
        real64 rr := 0.0
        real64 pp := 0.0
        for: k < size
            if k == j
                continue
            partial := -inverse[j][k] / matrix.root(inverse[j][j] * inverse[k][k])
            rr += correlation[j][k] * correlation[j][k]
            pp += partial * partial
        msa = msa.append(rr / (rr + pp))
        rr_total += rr
        pp_total += pp
    kmo := rr_total / (rr_total + pp_total)
    bartlett := -(matrix.as_real(n - 1) - matrix.as_real(2 * size + 5) / 6.0) * matrix.logarithm(determinant)
    return Adequacy(msa, determinant, kmo, bartlett, size * (size - 1) / 2)

real64[] parallel_analysis(int n, int size, int repetitions, int seed)
    totals := matrix.zeros(size)
    state := seed
    for _ < repetitions
        real64[][] rows := []
        for: i < n
            real64[] row := []
            for: j < size
                state = (48271 * state) % 2147483647
                row = row.append(matrix.as_real(state) / 2147483647.0)
            rows = rows.append(row)
        prepared := pca.prepare(rows, "correlation")
        result := eigen.jacobi(prepared.values)
        total := sum_values(result.values)
        for: k < size
            totals[k] += result.values[k] / total
    for: k < size
        totals[k] /= matrix.as_real(repetitions)
    return totals

Retention retention(real64[] values, real64[] parallel_values, int n, dataset.Params params)
    size := int(#values)
    total := sum_values(values)
    average := total / matrix.as_real(size)
    real64 cumulative := 0.0
    real64[] ratios := []
    real64[] cumulatives := []
    real64[] broken := []
    real64[] standard_errors := []
    bool[] separated := []
    criteria := [0, size, size, size]
    broken_found := false
    parallel_found := false
    cumulative_found := false
    for: k < size
        ratio := values[k] / total
        cumulative = if k == 0 then ratio else cumulative + ratio
        ratios = ratios.append(ratio)
        cumulatives = cumulatives.append(cumulative)
        real64 value := 0.0
        for: k + 1 <= index <= size
            value += 1.0 / matrix.as_real(index)
        broken = broken.append(value / matrix.as_real(size))
        standard_error := values[k] * matrix.root(2.0 / matrix.as_real(n))
        standard_errors = standard_errors.append(standard_error)
        isolated := true
        neighbors := [k - 1, k + 1]
        for other := neighbors[]
            if other >= 0 and other < size and matrix.absolute(values[k] - values[other]) <= standard_error
                isolated = false
        separated = separated.append(isolated)
        if values[k] > average
            criteria[0] += 1
        if not broken_found and ratio <= broken[k]
            criteria[1] = k
            broken_found = true
        if not parallel_found and ratio <= parallel_values[k]
            criteria[2] = k
            parallel_found = true
        if not cumulative_found and cumulative >= params.cumulative
            criteria[3] = k + 1
            cumulative_found = true
    retained := 1
    if params.components == "kaiser"
        retained = criteria[0]
    elif params.components == "broken_stick"
        retained = criteria[1]
    elif params.components == "parallel"
        retained = criteria[2]
    elif params.components == "cumulative"
        retained = criteria[3]
    else
        retained = dataset.integer(params.components)
    if retained < 1
        retained = 1
    return Retention(total, average, ratios, cumulatives, broken, standard_errors, separated, criteria, retained)

Loadings loading_analysis(real64[] values, real64[][] vectors, real64[][] analyzed, int count)
    real64[][] loadings := []
    real64[] communalities := []
    real64[][] correlations := []
    for: j < int(#values)
        real64[] row := []
        real64[] correlation := []
        real64 communality := 0.0
        for: k < int(#values)
            value := vectors[k][j] * matrix.root(values[k])
            row = row.append(value)
            if k < count
                communality += value * value
            if k < 2
                correlation = correlation.append(value / matrix.root(analyzed[j][j]))
        loadings = loadings.append(row)
        correlations = correlations.append(correlation)
        communalities = communalities.append(communality / analyzed[j][j])
    return Loadings(loadings, communalities, correlations)

real64 varimax_criterion(real64[][] values, int count)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for: k < count
        real64 q4 := 0.0
        real64 q2 := 0.0
        for: j < int(#values)
            square := values[j][k] * values[j][k]
            q4 += square * square
            q2 += square
        size := matrix.as_real(int(#values))
        result += q4 / size - (q2 / size) * (q2 / size)
    return result

Rotation varimax(real64[][] loadings, int count, int cycles)
    size := int(#loadings)
    real64[] lengths := []
    real64[][] normalized := []
    for: j < size
        real64 squared := 0.0
        for: k < count
            squared += loadings[j][k] * loadings[j][k]
        length := matrix.root(squared)
        lengths = lengths.append(length)
        real64[] row := []
        for: k < count
            row = row.append(loadings[j][k] / length)
        normalized = normalized.append(row)
    criteria := [varimax_criterion(normalized, count)]
    for _ < cycles
        for: a < count - 1
            for: a + 1 <= b < count
                real64 sa := 0.0
                real64 sb := 0.0
                real64 sc := 0.0
                real64 sd := 0.0
                for: j < size
                    first := normalized[j][a]
                    second := normalized[j][b]
                    phi := first * first - second * second
                    psi := 2.0 * first * second
                    sa += phi
                    sb += psi
                    sc += phi * phi - psi * psi
                    sd += 2.0 * phi * psi
                numerator := sd - 2.0 * sa * sb / matrix.as_real(size)
                denominator := sc - (sa * sa - sb * sb) / matrix.as_real(size)
                omega := matrix.root(numerator * numerator + denominator * denominator)
                if omega == 0.0
                    continue
                cos4 := denominator / omega
                sin4 := numerator / omega
                cos2 := matrix.root((1.0 + cos4) / 2.0)
                sin2 := if cos2 == 0.0 then 1.0 else sin4 / (2.0 * cos2)
                cos1 := matrix.root((1.0 + cos2) / 2.0)
                sin1 := sin2 / (2.0 * cos1)
                for: j < size
                    first := normalized[j][a]
                    second := normalized[j][b]
                    normalized[j][a] = cos1 * first + sin1 * second
                    normalized[j][b] = -sin1 * first + cos1 * second
        criteria = criteria.append(varimax_criterion(normalized, count))
    real64[][] columns := []
    real64[] squares := []
    for: k < count
        real64[] column := []
        for: j < size
            column = column.append(normalized[j][k] * lengths[j])
        column = matrix.orient(column)
        columns = columns.append(column)
        squares = squares.append(matrix.dot(column, column))
    order := top_indices(squares, count)
    rotated := matrix.empty_matrix(size, count)
    real64[] ss := []
    int[] closest := []
    real64[] congruences := []
    for: k < count
        source := order[k]
        ss = ss.append(squares[source])
        for: j < size
            rotated[j][k] = columns[source][j]
        real64[] values := []
        for: component < count
            values = values.append(matrix.absolute(congruence(columns[source], matrix.column(loadings, component))))
        selected := argmax(values)
        closest = closest.append(selected)
        congruences = congruences.append(values[selected])
    return Rotation(rotated, ss, criteria, closest, congruences)

Diagnostic[] diagnose(real64[][] standardized, real64[][] scores, real64[] values, real64[][] vectors, int count, real64 t2_limit, real64 spe_limit, bool quality_needed)
    Diagnostic[] result := []
    for: i < int(#standardized)
        row := standardized[i]
        residual := pca.residual(row, scores[i], vectors, count)
        t2 := pca.t2(scores[i], values, count)
        spe := matrix.dot(residual, residual)
        real64 represented := 0.0
        for: k < count
            represented += scores[i][k] * scores[i][k]
        quality := if quality_needed then represented / matrix.dot(row, row) else 0.0
        flag := (if t2 > t2_limit then "T" else "") + (if spe > spe_limit then "Q" else "")
        if flag == ""
            flag = "-"
        real64[] t2_contributions := []
        real64[] spe_contributions := []
        for: j < int(#row)
            real64 weight := 0.0
            for: k < count
                weight += (scores[i][k] / values[k]) * vectors[k][j]
            t2_contributions = t2_contributions.append(row[j] * weight)
            spe_contributions = spe_contributions.append(residual[j] * residual[j])
        result = result.append(Diagnostic(t2, spe, quality, flag, t2_contributions, spe_contributions))
    return result

Nearest[] supplementary_nearest(real64[][] scores, real64[][] reference, int count)
    Nearest[] result := []
    for row := scores[]
        nearest := -1
        real64 minimum := 0.0
        for: index < int(#reference)
            real64 distance := 0.0
            for: k < count
                distance += (row[k] - reference[index][k]) * (row[k] - reference[index][k])
            if nearest < 0 or distance < minimum
                nearest = index
                minimum = distance
        result = result.append(Nearest(nearest, matrix.root(minimum)))
    return result

class Analysis(dataset.Inputs data, Summary[] summaries, string[] incomplete, string[] ids, pca.Prepared prepared, eigen.Result eigen_result, eigen.Power[] powered, real64[] parallel_values, Retention retained, Loadings loading, Rotation rotation, real64[][] scores, Diagnostic[] diagnostics, real64[][] supplementary_scores, Diagnostic[] supplementary_diagnostics, Nearest[] nearest, Adequacy adequacy)

string[] eigen_report(Analysis analysis)
    data := analysis.data.data
    params := analysis.data.params
    prepared := analysis.prepared
    result := analysis.eigen_result
    retained := analysis.retained
    count := retained.retained
    size := int(#data.variables)
    lines := ["pca rows {#data.rows} used {#analysis.ids} variables {size} missing {params.missing} scaling {params.scaling}"]
    incomplete := if #analysis.incomplete == 0 then "-" else analysis.incomplete.join(" ")
    lines = lines.concat(["incomplete {#analysis.incomplete} {incomplete}", "", "variable observed missing mean sd min max msa"])
    for: j < size
        summary := analysis.summaries[j]
        lines = lines.append(data.variables[j] + " {summary.observed} {summary.missing} " + reals([summary.mean, summary.sd, summary.minimum, summary.maximum, analysis.adequacy.msa[j]]))
    adequacy := analysis.adequacy
    lines = lines.concat(["adequacy kmo " + number(adequacy.kmo) + " determinant " + number(adequacy.determinant, 6) + " bartlett " + number(adequacy.bartlett) + " df {adequacy.degrees}", "", "matrix {params.scaling}"])
    for: j < size
        lines = lines.append(data.variables[j] + " " + reals(prepared.values[j]))
    int[][] pairs := []
    real64[] magnitudes := []
    for: j < size - 1
        for: j + 1 <= k < size
            pairs = pairs.append([j, k])
            magnitudes = magnitudes.append(matrix.absolute(prepared.correlation[j][k]))
    string[] strongest := []
    for index := top_indices(magnitudes, params.top)[]
        pair := pairs[index]
        strongest = strongest.append(data.variables[pair[0]] + ":" + data.variables[pair[1]] + ":" + number(prepared.correlation[pair[0]][pair[1]]))
    lines = lines.concat([
        "strongest " + strongest.join(" "),
        "",
        "jacobi sweeps {result.sweeps}",
        "eigenvalues total " + number(retained.total) + " average " + number(retained.average),
        "k eigenvalue ratio cumulative broken_stick parallel se separated",
    ])
    for: k < size
        values := [result.values[k], retained.ratios[k], retained.cumulative[k], retained.broken[k], analysis.parallel_values[k], retained.standard_errors[k]]
        lines = lines.append("{k + 1} " + reals(values) + " " + (if retained.separated[k] then "yes" else "no"))
    criteria := retained.criteria
    lines = lines.concat([
        "retention kaiser {criteria[0]} broken_stick {criteria[1]} parallel {criteria[2]} cumulative {criteria[3]} target " + number(params.cumulative),
        "components {count} rule {params.components}",
        "",
        "eigenvectors",
    ])
    header := ["variable"]
    for: 1 <= k <= size
        header = header.append("pc{k}")
    lines = lines.append(header.join(" "))
    for: j < size
        real64[] values := []
        for: k < size
            values = values.append(result.vectors[k][j])
        lines = lines.append(data.variables[j] + " " + reals(values))
    lines = lines.concat(["", "power_iteration iterations 1000", "k jacobi power agree_at match"])
    matched := 0
    for: k < size
        powered := analysis.powered[k]
        if powered.matched
            matched += 1
        agreement := if powered.agreement < 0 then "-" else "{powered.agreement}"
        lines = lines.append("{k + 1} " + number(result.values[k]) + " " + number(powered.value) + " {agreement} " + (if powered.matched then "yes" else "no"))
    lines = lines.concat(["cross_check {matched}/{size}", "", "scores", "component sd min min_id max max_id contributors"])
    for: k < count
        column := matrix.column(analysis.scores, k)
        real64 squared := 0.0
        minimum := 0
        maximum := 0
        real64[] contributions := []
        for: i < int(#column)
            value := column[i]
            squared += value * value
            if value < column[minimum]
                minimum = i
            if value > column[maximum]
                maximum = i
            contributions = contributions.append(value * value / (matrix.as_real(int(#analysis.ids) - 1) * result.values[k]))
        string[] fields := []
        for i := top_indices(contributions, params.top)[]
            fields = fields.append(analysis.ids[i] + ":" + number(contributions[i]))
        lines = lines.append("pc{k + 1} " + number(matrix.root(squared / matrix.as_real(int(#analysis.ids) - 1))) + " " + number(column[minimum]) + " " + analysis.ids[minimum] + " " + number(column[maximum]) + " " + analysis.ids[maximum] + " " + fields.join(" "))
    lines = lines.concat(["", "varimax components {count} cycles {params.cycles}"])
    for: index < int(#analysis.rotation.criteria)
        lines = lines.append("cycle {index} criterion " + number(analysis.rotation.criteria[index], 6))
    for: k < count
        lines = lines.append("rc{k + 1} ss " + number(analysis.rotation.squares[k]) + " ratio " + number(analysis.rotation.squares[k] / retained.total) + " closest pc{analysis.rotation.closest[k] + 1} congruence " + number(analysis.rotation.congruences[k]))
    lines = lines.concat(["", "sensitivity", "missing scaling rows sweeps eigenvalues cumulative congruence"])
    string[][] combinations := [["listwise", "covariance"], ["listwise", "correlation"], ["mean", "covariance"], ["mean", "correlation"]]
    for combination := combinations[]
        alternative := analysis_data(data.ids, data.rows, analysis.summaries, combination[0])
        prepared_variant := pca.prepare(alternative.rows, combination[1])
        variant := eigen.jacobi(prepared_variant.values)
        total := sum_values(variant.values)
        real64 cumulative := 0.0
        real64[] values := []
        real64[] agreements := []
        for: k < count
            values = values.append(variant.values[k])
            ratio := variant.values[k] / total
            cumulative = if k == 0 then ratio else cumulative + ratio
            agreements = agreements.append(matrix.absolute(matrix.dot(variant.vectors[k], result.vectors[k])))
        lines = lines.append(combination[0] + " " + combination[1] + " {#alternative.ids} {variant.sweeps} " + reals(values) + " " + number(cumulative) + " " + reals(agreements))
    return lines

string[] loadings_report(Analysis analysis)
    count := analysis.retained.retained
    header := ["variable"]

        header = header.append("rc{k}")

        for: k < count

    count := analysis.retained.retained

string[] outliers_report(Analysis analysis)
    params := analysis.data.params
    count := analysis.retained.retained
    lines := ["diagnostics components {count} t2_limit " + number(params.t2_limit) + " spe_limit " + number(params.spe_limit), "id t2 spe quality flag"]
    flagged_t := 0
    flagged_q := 0
    both := 0
    any := 0
    real64[] t2_values := []
    real64[] spe_values := []
    for: index < int(#analysis.diagnostics)
        row := analysis.diagnostics[index]
        lines = lines.append(analysis.ids[index] + " " + reals([row.t2, row.spe, row.quality]) + " {row.flag}")
        if row.flag.contains("T")
            flagged_t += 1
        if row.flag.contains("Q")
            flagged_q += 1
        if row.flag == "TQ"
            both += 1
        if row.flag != "-"
            any += 1
        t2_values = t2_values.append(row.t2)
        spe_values = spe_values.append(row.spe)
    lines = lines.append("flagged t2 {flagged_t} spe {flagged_q} both {both} any {any}")
    modes := ["t2", "spe"]
    for mode := modes[]
        lines = lines.concat(["", "top {mode}", "rank id {mode} variable contribution"])
        values := if mode == "t2" then t2_values else spe_values
        order := top_indices(values, params.top)
        for: rank < int(#order)
            index := order[rank]
            row := analysis.diagnostics[index]
            contributions := if mode == "t2" then row.t2_contributions else row.spe_contributions
            variable := argmax(contributions)
            lines = lines.append("{rank + 1} " + analysis.ids[index] + " " + number(values[index]) + " " + analysis.data.data.variables[variable] + " " + number(contributions[variable]))
    lines = lines.concat(["", "reconstruction", "k mean_spe max_spe max_id"])
    for: 1 <= k < int(#analysis.data.data.variables)
        real64 total := 0.0
        real64 maximum := 0.0
        maximum_index := -1
        for: i < int(#analysis.prepared.standardized)
            row := analysis.prepared.standardized[i]
            residual := pca.residual(row, analysis.scores[i], analysis.eigen_result.vectors, k)
            spe := matrix.dot(residual, residual)
            total += spe
            if maximum_index < 0 or spe > maximum
                maximum = spe
                maximum_index = i
        lines = lines.append("{k} " + number(total / matrix.as_real(int(#analysis.ids))) + " " + number(maximum) + " " + analysis.ids[maximum_index])
    header := ["id"]
    for: 1 <= k <= count
        header = header.append("pc{k}")
    header = header.concat(["t2", "spe", "flag", "nearest", "distance"])
    lines = lines.concat(["", "supplementary", header.join(" ")])
    for: i < int(#analysis.data.supplementary.ids)
        fields := [analysis.data.supplementary.ids[i]]
        for: k < count
            fields = fields.append(number(analysis.supplementary_scores[i][k]))
        row := analysis.supplementary_diagnostics[i]
        nearest := analysis.nearest[i]
        fields = fields.concat([number(row.t2), number(row.spe), row.flag, analysis.ids[nearest.index], number(nearest.distance)])
        lines = lines.append(fields.join(" "))
    return lines

void axes(string[][] &grid, int row, int column)
    for: index < int(#grid[0])
        grid[row][index] = "-"
    for: index < int(#grid)
        grid[index][column] = "|"
    grid[row][column] = "+"

void draw_points(string[][] &grid, plot.Cell[] cells)
    int[][] counts := []
    for: row < int(#grid)
        values := [for value := grid[row][] then 0]
        counts = counts.append(values)
    for cell := cells[]
        counts[cell.row][cell.column] += 1
    for: row < int(#grid)
        for: column < int(#grid[row])
            count := counts[row][column]
            if count > 0
                grid[row][column] = if count == 1 then "." elif count <= 3 then "o" else "@"

bool inside_circle(int row, int column, int center_row, int center_column, int radius)
    return (column - center_column) * (column - center_column) + (2 * (row - center_row)) * (2 * (row - center_row)) <= radius * radius

string[] plots_report(Analysis analysis)
    params := analysis.data.params
    result := analysis.eigen_result
    retained := analysis.retained
    width := params.scree_width
    kaiser := plot.floor_value(retained.average / result.values[0] * matrix.as_real(width) + 0.5)
    lines := ["scree width {width} kaiser_column {kaiser}"]
    for: k < int(#result.values)
        value := result.values[k]
        length := plot.floor_value(value / result.values[0] * matrix.as_real(width) + 0.5)
        broken := plot.floor_value(retained.broken[k] * retained.total / result.values[0] * matrix.as_real(width) + 0.5)
        lines = lines.append("|" + plot.scree(width, length, kaiser, broken) + "| pc{k + 1} " + number(value))
    width = params.biplot_width
    height := params.biplot_height
    real64 maximum_x := 0.0
    real64 maximum_y := 0.0
    for: collection < 2
        scores := if collection == 0 then analysis.scores else analysis.supplementary_scores
        for row := scores[]
            if matrix.absolute(row[0]) > maximum_x
                maximum_x = matrix.absolute(row[0])
            if matrix.absolute(row[1]) > maximum_y
                maximum_y = matrix.absolute(row[1])
    real64 largest_x := 0.0
    real64 largest_y := 0.0
    for row := analysis.loading.values[]
        if matrix.absolute(row[0]) > largest_x
            largest_x = matrix.absolute(row[0])
        if matrix.absolute(row[1]) > largest_y
            largest_y = matrix.absolute(row[1])
    first_ratio := maximum_x / largest_x
    second_ratio := maximum_y / largest_y
    arrow_scale := 0.9 * (if first_ratio < second_ratio then first_ratio else second_ratio)
    grid := plot.grid(width, height)
    origin := plot.cell(0.0, 0.0, maximum_x, maximum_y, width, height)
    axes(&grid, origin.row, origin.column)
    plot.Cell[] tips := []
    for row := analysis.loading.values[]
        tip := plot.cell(arrow_scale * row[0], arrow_scale * row[1], maximum_x, maximum_y, width, height)
        tips = tips.append(tip)
        for cell := plot.shaft(origin.row, origin.column, tip.row, tip.column)[]
            grid[cell.row][cell.column] = cell.character
    plot.Cell[] cells := []
    for row := analysis.scores[]
        cells = cells.append(plot.cell(row[0], row[1], maximum_x, maximum_y, width, height))
    draw_points(&grid, cells)
    for: index < int(#cells)
        cell := cells[index]
        if analysis.diagnostics[index].flag != "-"
            grid[cell.row][cell.column] = "X"
    for row := analysis.supplementary_scores[]
        cell := plot.cell(row[0], row[1], maximum_x, maximum_y, width, height)
        grid[cell.row][cell.column] = "*"
    letters := "ABCDEFGHIJKL"
    for: j < int(#tips)
        tip := tips[j]
        grid[tip.row][tip.column] = letters[j]
    lines = lines.concat([
        "",
        "biplot pc1 pc2 width {width} height {height}",
        "x " + number(-maximum_x) + " " + number(maximum_x) + " y " + number(-maximum_y) + " " + number(maximum_y) + " arrow_scale " + number(arrow_scale),
    ])
    lines = lines.concat(plot.frame(grid))
    for: j < int(#analysis.data.data.variables)
        lines = lines.append(letters[j] + " " + analysis.data.data.variables[j] + " " + reals(analysis.loading.values[j][0:<2]))
    radius := params.radius
    width = 2 * radius + 3
    height = radius + 3
    center_row := radius / 2 + 1
    center_column := radius + 1
    grid = plot.grid(width, height)
    axes(&grid, center_row, center_column)
    for: int row < height
        for: int column < width
            adjacent_outside := not inside_circle(row - 1, column, center_row, center_column, radius) or not inside_circle(row + 1, column, center_row, center_column, radius) or not inside_circle(row, column - 1, center_row, center_column, radius) or not inside_circle(row, column + 1, center_row, center_column, radius)
            if inside_circle(row, column, center_row, center_column, radius) and adjacent_outside
                grid[row][column] = "."
    for: j < int(#analysis.loading.correlations)
        row := analysis.loading.correlations[j]
        cell_row := center_row - plot.floor_value(row[1] * matrix.as_real(radius / 2) + 0.5)
        column := center_column + plot.floor_value(row[0] * matrix.as_real(radius) + 0.5)
        grid[cell_row][column] = letters[j]
    lines = lines.concat(["", "circle radius {radius}"]).concat(plot.frame(grid))
    for: j < int(#analysis.data.data.variables)
        row := analysis.loading.correlations[j]
        lines = lines.append(letters[j] + " " + analysis.data.data.variables[j] + " " + reals([row[0], row[1], row[0] * row[0] + row[1] * row[1]]))
    width = params.diagnostic_width
    height = params.diagnostic_height
    maximum_t2 := 2.0 * params.t2_limit
    maximum_spe := 2.0 * params.spe_limit
    grid = plot.grid(width, height)
    limit := plot.diagnostic_cell(params.t2_limit, params.spe_limit, maximum_t2, maximum_spe, width, height)
    axes(&grid, limit.row, limit.column)
    cells = []
    for row := analysis.diagnostics[]
        cells = cells.append(plot.diagnostic_cell(row.t2, row.spe, maximum_t2, maximum_spe, width, height))
    draw_points(&grid, cells)
    for row := analysis.supplementary_diagnostics[]
        cell := plot.diagnostic_cell(row.t2, row.spe, maximum_t2, maximum_spe, width, height)
        grid[cell.row][cell.column] = "*"
    lines = lines.concat(["", "diagnostic width {width} height {height} t2_max " + number(maximum_t2) + " spe_max " + number(maximum_spe)])
    return lines.concat(plot.frame(grid))

void save(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

void run()
    input := dataset.read_inputs()
    data := input.data
    params := input.params
    descriptive := summarize(data.ids, data.rows, int(#data.variables))
    retained_data := analysis_data(data.ids, data.rows, descriptive.summaries, params.missing)
    prepared := pca.prepare(retained_data.rows, params.scaling)
    result := eigen.jacobi(prepared.values)
    powered := eigen.power(prepared.values, result)
    parallel_values := parallel_analysis(int(#retained_data.rows), int(#data.variables), params.repetitions, params.seed)
    retained := retention(result.values, parallel_values, int(#retained_data.rows), params)
    loading := loading_analysis(result.values, result.vectors, prepared.values, retained.retained)
    rotation := varimax(loading.values, retained.retained, params.cycles)
    scores := pca.scores(prepared.standardized, result.vectors)
    diagnosed := diagnose(prepared.standardized, scores, result.values, result.vectors, retained.retained, params.t2_limit, params.spe_limit, true)
    supplementary := pca.supplementary(input.supplementary.rows, prepared.means, prepared.scales)
    supplementary_scores := pca.scores(supplementary, result.vectors)
    supplementary_diagnostics := diagnose(supplementary, supplementary_scores, result.values, result.vectors, retained.retained, params.t2_limit, params.spe_limit, false)
    nearest := supplementary_nearest(supplementary_scores, scores, retained.retained)
    adequacy := sampling_adequacy(prepared.correlation, int(#retained_data.rows))
    analysis := Analysis(input, descriptive.summaries, descriptive.incomplete, retained_data.ids, prepared, result, powered, parallel_values, retained, loading, rotation, scores, diagnosed, supplementary_scores, supplementary_diagnostics, nearest, adequacy)
    exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    save("eigen.txt", eigen_report(analysis))
    save("loadings.csv", loadings_report(analysis))
    save("scores.csv", scores_report(analysis))
    save("outliers.txt", outliers_report(analysis))
    save("plots.txt", plots_report(analysis))

run()

import math

real64 as_real(int value)
    result := real64(value)
    return result

real64 root(real64 value)
    result := math.sqrt(value)
    return result

real64 logarithm(real64 value)
    result := math.log(value)
    return result

real64 absolute(real64 value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -value else value

real64[] zeros(int count)
    return [for index := (0:<count)[] then 0.0]

real64[][] empty_matrix(int rows, int columns)
    return [for index := (0:<rows)[] then zeros(columns)]

real64[][] copy(real64[][] values)
    return values

real64[][] identity(int size)
    result := empty_matrix(size, size)
    for: index < size
        result[index][index] = 1.0
    return result

real64[] column(real64[][] values, int index)
    return [for row := values[] then row[index]]

real64 dot(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for: index < int(#first)
        result += first[index] * second[index]
    return result

real64[] product(real64[][] values, real64[] vector)
    return [for row := values[] then dot(row, vector)]

real64 length(real64[] vector)
    return root(dot(vector, vector))

real64[] normalize(real64[] vector)
    norm := length(vector)
    return [for value := vector[] then value / norm]

real64[] orient(real64[] vector)
    largest := 0
    for: 1 <= index < int(#vector)
        if absolute(vector[index]) > absolute(vector[largest])
            largest = index
    return if vector[largest] < 0.0 then [for value := vector[] then -value] else vector

real64 maximum_difference(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for: index < int(#first)
        difference := absolute(first[index] - second[index])
        if difference > result
            result = difference
    return result

real64[][] deflate(real64[][] values, real64 eigenvalue, real64[] vector)
    result := copy(values)
    for: i < int(#values)
        for: j < int(#values)
            result[i][j] = values[i][j] - eigenvalue * vector[i] * vector[j]
    return result

class Inverse(real64[][] values, real64 determinant)

Inverse inverse_determinant(real64[][] values)
    size := int(#values)
    real64[][] work := []
    unit := identity(size)
    for: index < size
        work = work.append(values[index].concat(unit[index]))
    real64 determinant := 1.0
    for: k < size
        pivot := work[k][k]
        determinant *= pivot
        for: h < 2 * size
            work[k][h] /= pivot
        for: i < size
            if i == k
                continue
            factor := work[i][k]
            for: h < 2 * size
                work[i][h] -= factor * work[k][h]
    real64[][] inverse := []
    for: i < size
        inverse = inverse.append(work[i][size:<2 * size])
    return Inverse(inverse, determinant)

import matrix = "./matrix.qui"

class Prepared(real64[] means, real64[] deviations, real64[] scales, real64[][] covariance, real64[][] correlation, real64[][] values, real64[][] standardized)

real64[][] standardize(real64[][] rows, real64[] means, real64[] scales)
    real64[][] result := []
    for row := rows[]
        real64[] values := []
        for: j < int(#means)
            values = values.append((row[j] - means[j]) / scales[j])
        result = result.append(values)
    return result

Prepared prepare(real64[][] rows, string scaling)
    n := int(#rows)
    size := int(#rows[0])
    real64[] means := []
    for: j < size
        real64 sum := 0.0
        for: i < n
            sum += rows[i][j]
        means = means.append(sum / matrix.as_real(n))
    covariance := matrix.empty_matrix(size, size)
    correlation := matrix.empty_matrix(size, size)
    real64[] deviations := []
    real64[] scales := []
    for: j < size
        for: j <= k < size
            real64 sum := 0.0
            for: i < n
                sum += (rows[i][j] - means[j]) * (rows[i][k] - means[k])
            covariance[j][k] = sum / matrix.as_real(n - 1)
            covariance[k][j] = covariance[j][k]
        deviations = deviations.append(matrix.root(covariance[j][j]))
        scales = scales.append(if scaling == "covariance" then 1.0 else deviations[j])
    for: j < size
        for: k < size
            correlation[j][k] = if j == k then 1.0 else covariance[j][k] / (deviations[j] * deviations[k])
    values := if scaling == "covariance" then covariance else correlation
    return Prepared(means, deviations, scales, covariance, correlation, values, standardize(rows, means, scales))

real64[][] supplementary(string[][] rows, real64[] means, real64[] scales)
    real64[][] result := []
    for row := rows[]
        real64[] values := []
        for: j < int(#means)
            real64 value := 0.0
            if row[j] != "NA"
                parsed := real64(row[j])
                value = (parsed - means[j]) / scales[j]
            values = values.append(value)
        result = result.append(values)
    return result

real64[][] scores(real64[][] standardized, real64[][] vectors)
    real64[][] result := []
    for row := standardized[]
        values := [for vector := vectors[] then matrix.dot(row, vector)]
        result = result.append(values)
    return result

real64[] residual(real64[] row, real64[] score_values, real64[][] vectors, int count)
    real64[] result := []
    for: j < int(#row)
        real64 reconstructed := 0.0
        for: k < count
            reconstructed += score_values[k] * vectors[k][j]
        result = result.append(row[j] - reconstructed)
    return result

real64 t2(real64[] score_values, real64[] eigenvalues, int count)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for: k < count
        result += (score_values[k] * score_values[k]) / eigenvalues[k]
    return result

class Cell(int row, int column)
class Shaft(int row, int column, string character)

Cell cell(real64 x, real64 y, real64 maximum_x, real64 maximum_y, int width, int height)
    column := floor_value((x + maximum_x) / (2.0 * maximum_x) * as_real(width))
    row := floor_value((maximum_y - y) / (2.0 * maximum_y) * as_real(height))
    if column >= width
        column = width - 1
    if row >= height
        row = height - 1
    return Cell(row, column)

Cell diagnostic_cell(real64 t2, real64 spe, real64 maximum_x, real64 maximum_y, int width, int height)
    column := floor_value(t2 / maximum_x * as_real(width))
    vertical := floor_value(spe / maximum_y * as_real(height))
    columns := width
    rows := height
    if column >= columns
        column = columns - 1
    if vertical >= rows
        vertical = rows - 1
    return Cell(rows - 1 - vertical, column)

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

int sign(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -1 elif value > 0 then 1 else 0

Shaft[] shaft(int origin_row, int origin_column, int tip_row, int tip_column)
    dc := tip_column - origin_column
    dr := tip_row - origin_row
    steps := if absolute(dc) > absolute(dr) then absolute(dc) else absolute(dr)
    character := if 2 * absolute(dr) <= absolute(dc) then "-" elif 2 * absolute(dc) <= absolute(dr) then "|" elif dc * dr < 0 then "/" else "\"
    Shaft[] result := []
    for: 1 <= step < steps
        column := origin_column + sign(dc) * ((2 * step * absolute(dc) + steps) / (2 * steps))
        row := origin_row + sign(dr) * ((2 * step * absolute(dr) + steps) / (2 * steps))
        result = result.append(Shaft(row, column, character))
    return result

string scree(int width, int length, int kaiser, int broken)
    result := ""
    for: 1 <= position <= width
        result += if position == broken then "o" elif position == kaiser then ":" elif position <= length then "#" else " "
    return result
